theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Compounding: Your Money's Best Friend Over Time
body: Regular investments let you buy more units when prices fall, fewer when they rise. Time amplifies growth through compounding returns.
caption: Small, consistent investments can build substantial wealth through the compounding effect over decades. Market volatility becomes your advantage through rupee cost averaging. Start your wealth journey today with disciplined investing. #SIPPower #CompoundingEffect #RupeeCostAveraging #WealthBuilding #InvestSmart
